read_policy_note: Images were read one per step with notes taken before the next read, except sequence-046.png and sequence-047.png, which were sent in a single parallel step by mistake. Both were received and noted separately.

pages.observed: Backyard with porch, rubber boots, chain-link post with orange tag and skyline. No water visible. The caption from 0.6 s covers the boots.
Same yard with a slight drift. The caption covers the boots and a brown soil band behind the fence shows no readable water.
Disclosure label changes to the map note and a small Texas outline inset draws at top right. The yard is unchanged.
Inset outline completes. The caption clears at 3.6 s, revealing boots with a faint ring. The brown band reads as mud.
Cut to a dark phone lying on a white porch ledge above balusters. The UT San Antonio caption appears at 4.4 s.
Phone dark, vibration ticks at 5.6 s, Flash Flood Warning banner appears at 5.8 s with its title clipped, and a county dot appears in the inset.
Warning banner held on the phone with its text clipped at the banner edge. The inset marker is visible, then fades.
Static hold of the warning phone and its caption. The county inset fades out at 7.8 s.
Phone holds and the prototype label appears over it at 8.2 s. Caption clears at 8.4 s. Cut at 8.8 s to the station pole with a cropped box and pods.
Pull-back reveals the full station with solar panel, antenna, pods and a Prototype flood station callout. The caption covers the base.
Static wide shot of the station with callout, trees and skyline. The built-station caption sits over the post base.
Caption clears at 11.4 s, showing a glow at the base. Cut at 11.6 s to a close of the box and panel beside a reflective creek.
Sunbeam hits the panel, a Charges from light callout pins, and the battery meter goes from orange to four green bars.
Full meter holds. Cut at 13.6 s to the wide station with a lattice cell tower, and a faint callout starts to appear.
No cell tower needed label with a leader to the tower. A dashed line runs from the antenna to a circle in the sky. Static.
Caption cleared and a yellow light at the pole base. Cut at 15.8 s to three sensor pods close, with a flat brown lower half.
Four optical sensors label and caption, but only three pods visible. Creek appears behind and a brown slab fills the lower frame.
Opaque brown band rises over the lowest pod, leaving a ghost. A seam strip of grass and water shows at the bottom edge.
Brown slab covers two pods with a hard edge and a grass corner. Cut at 18.4 s to the box close with Rain, Temperature and Humidity labels.
Rain, Temperature, Humidity and Light labels. Caption clears at 19.2 s. Cut at 19.8 s to a flat TinyML circuit board labelled not real hardware.
Static board diagram floating over the creek with no pole. The small-chip caption is shown below.
Board stays static until 21.8 s, when tiny light dots begin moving along the traces toward the chip.
Pulses travel along the traces into the TinyML chip and the chip outline glows yellow from 22.4 s.
Chip glow holds with no caption from 23.2 to 23.6 s, then a push-in and the central-server caption at 23.8 s.
Push-in on the chip. An orange LED lights at 24.6 s and a Judged on the station tag appears at 24.8 s.
Tag and chip glow hold. Cut at 25.4 s to a wide shot with the station at the right edge and a chip icon on its box.
Faint dotted server outline near the left tree with a tiny No line to it label. Two yellow lamps glow at the pole base.
Cut at 27.2 s to a street: station at left, a road with a brown rectangle, a house at right and water in the foreground. Radio caption.
Concentric yellow rings expand from the antenna into the sky. They never move down the street.
Rings fade. A More than a half-mile tag flies in near the house at the end of a short street.
Static street hold with the tag and the brown slab on the road. The caption clears at 30.8 s.
Cut at 31.2 s to an open park field with a small Hub building, a metal frame, a mast and the skyline. Five-mile caption from 31.6 s.
An arc grows from off-frame left over the tree toward the mast. An Up to five miles tag appears at 32.8 s.
Arcs reach the mast and its tip lights yellow at 33.2 s. The tag holds and the downtown skyline stays behind.
Arcs continue and the mast stays lit, but the hub building is unchanged. The caption clears at 34.8 s.
Field fades. Cut at 35.4 s to a desk with a Flood spread map monitor showing a line chart, keyboard, cup and a navy sleeved arm.
A second larger model tag appears and dots light on the chart. The detached arm swings rigidly until it lies along the desk.
Static hold of the dotted chart and the arm with a dark lump hand. The caption is an incomplete sentence.
Push into a full-frame Flood spread map. Orange blobs spread along the chart line and the flood paths caption appears at 38.8 s.
Blobs hold. A Higher risk legend, dashed boxes and a For emergency responders tag appear on the chart.
Static chart. The caption clears at 40.4 s, leaving a blank beige lower frame.
Cut to a flat olive background with a Validation accuracy card and an empty bar. University validation caption.
The validation card is static until the bar begins filling orange at 42.8 s.
98.82% appears and the bar fills nearly full by 43.4 s, then holds still.
Static validation card. The caption clears at 44.6 s on the flat olive background.
The validation card scales up while the ninety eight point eight two percent caption appears.
An Initial assessments after training tag attaches under the 98.82% card at 46.4 s.
Completely static validation card and tag, with the accuracy caption underneath.
A second card edge cropped to Fi peeks in at the right. The caption clears at 48.6 s.
Pull-back to a small validation card beside a blank Field result card, then a pan right. No field result caption.
A None reported stamp lands on the Field result card at 50.4 s, beside the cropped validation card.
Static hold of the stamped Field result card and the cropped validation card with their caption.
Cut at 52.2 s to a pole and wire with a translucent sheet that becomes an opaque grid map with a creek line. No-town caption.
Static grid map. A dashed search circle flashes at 53.6 s and is gone by 53.8 s.
A No installation named tag pins on the map at 54.4 s. The caption clears at 54.8 s.
Map holds, then a pull-back at 55.6 s to a park with the map on a chain-link frame, a road and the skyline. Deployment caption.
A dashed station outline appears at left in the park at 56.6 s, with the caption covering its base.
Dashed outline complete and a Deployment goal tag pins. The caption clears at 57.4 s, leaving the tags floating in the sky.
Completely static closing tableau: dashed station outline, map frame, goal and no-installation tags.
Tableau holds to 59.2 s, then a cut at 59.4 s to a credits card with the Lone Star flag and Texas AI Docket.
Static credits card with texasaidocket.com and the UT San Antonio Today, September 8th source line.
Static credits card unchanged, with legible sources, illustration and map editorial lines.
Static credits card unchanged, with the Texas AI Docket wordmark and the County marker is editorial note.
Static credits card unchanged through 63.8 s, with the flag, wordmark, URL and source lines.
The credits card holds unchanged to the final frame at 64.367 s. No further picture content.
